name: pw-tracescrub
description: Scrub secrets from Playwright traces, HAR files, reports and storageState before they become CI artifacts
author: Gary Parker

scripts.demo:video: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble sh -c "npm run build && npx playwright test --config=demo/playwright.config.ts" && for o in landscape portrait; do ffmpeg -loglevel error -y $(cat demo/out/cut-$o.txt) -i demo/out/tracescrub-$o.webm -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an demo/out/tracescrub-$o.mp4; done
